heading: Today
text: Any early showers in NH ending.  Becoming partly sunny north, and mostly sunny south.  An isolated shower north late.  Breezy.  Highs in the upper 60s to mid 70s north, in the 70s to near 80 south.  Winds becoming west and increasing to 10 to 25 mph, gusting 30 to 40 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: A stray evening shower, mainly north, then gradual clearing north to south.  Some patchy fog north. Much cooler.  Lows in the 40s north, 40 in the cool spots, 50 to 55 south.  Winds becoming northwest 10 to 15 mph, gusting 20 to 30 mph, decreasing overnight.

heading: Friday
text: Mostly sunny and cool.  Highs in the 60s north, upper 60s to low 70s south.  Winds northwest near 10 mph from the Green Mountains west, 10 to 15 mph, gusting up to 25 mph east.
